topic: The Pi-Collision Paradox: Why Colliding Blocks Calculate Digits of Pi

sections.title: The Hook: The Bouncing Blocks Paradox
lecture_lines: Two blocks slide toward a wall.
A small block sits between wall and massive block.
Exponentially heavier blocks create more collisions.
Collisions count the digits of Pi.
animations: Create two squares using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/block.svg], label them 'M1' (#FF5733) and 'M2' (#33FF57).
Show M1 colliding with M2, M2 moves away.
Change color of 'M1' to #FFFF33 upon impact.
Show both blocks reversing direction after potential collision with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wall.svg].

sections.title: Prerequisite: Elastic Collisions and Conservation
lecture_lines: Elastic collisions conserve momentum and kinetic energy.
Equal masses simply exchange velocities upon impact.
Treat them as passing through each other.
animations: Display momentum formula p = mv in center (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Mapping Physics to Geometry
lecture_lines: Velocity vectors form a 2D particle plane.
Reflections hit a potential barrier wedge.
animations: Draw a 2D plane with two axes labeled x1 and x2.
Plot a diagonal line representing the conservation of energy.
Animate a point moving along this line as [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg] bounce.

sections.title: The Emergence of Pi
lecture_lines: Number of reflections depends on wedge angle.
Mass ratio makes the angle approach zero.
The particle traces a circle arc path.
Reflections define the ratio related to Pi.
Geometric limits reveal the hidden constant.
animations: Animate the point spiraling near the axes origin using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/particle.svg].
Overlay the digits of pi emerging near the trajectory.
Highlight the final crossing point of the trajectory.

sections.title: Summary and Conclusion
lecture_lines: Discrete collisions map to continuous geometry.
Mathematics emerges from simple physical systems.
Physics is the language of geometry.
animations: Reiterate the blocks-to-pi connection graphically using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg].
Display the final ratio of collision counts.
